mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_payment (payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time FROM pet_payment WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time FROM pet_payment WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
